arduino_uno.name: Arduino Uno (ATmega328P)
arduino_uno.supply: USB 5V or barrel jack 7-12V (onboard 5V/3V3 regs). Do NOT feed 5V into 5V pin while USB connected.
arduino_uno.gpio: 14 digital (6 PWM: 3,5,6,9,10,11), 6 analog in. Max ~20mA per pin, ~200mA total.

esp32.name: ESP32 DevKit
esp32.supply: USB 5V in, 3V3 rail. 5V-tolerant: NO — divide/shift 5V signals down.
esp32.gpio: Usable: most GPIO except strapping pins 0/2/12/15 at boot and 6-11 (flash). ADC1 usable with WiFi, ADC2 not.
gotchas: GPIO0/2/12/15 strapping — don't pull wrong at boot
Brownouts on weak USB — add bulk cap, short thick cable

breadboard.name: Solderless breadboard
breadboard.rails: Red/blue rails run LENGTHWISE and are often SPLIT in the middle — bridge them with jumpers.
breadboard.rows: Each numbered row: 5 holes connected (abcde | fghij), center gap isolates halves.
gotchas: High-current motors melt contacts — use screw terminals

led.name: LED + series resistor
led.polarity: Long leg = anode (+). Flat side / short leg = cathode (-). Reversed LED blocks, usually survives at 5V.
led.resistor_rule: (Vsupply - Vf) / I. Red Vf~2.0V, green/blue/white Vf~3.0-3.3V. Target 5-15mA for indicators.

gpio.name: GPIO basics
rules: Never drive a pin shorted to GND/VCC
Floating inputs drift — use INPUT_PULLUP or external 10k
One pin ≤20mA; drive motors/relays via transistor/MOSFET, never directly

sensors.name: Common sensors
sensors.dht22: Needs 3V3-5V, 10k pull-up on data, 2s between reads. NaN = timing/wiring, not broken sensor.
sensors.hc_sr04: 5V device, ECHO returns 5V — divide to 3V3 for ESP32. Needs common GND. Min ~2cm, beam ~15°.
sensors.i2c: SDA/SCL need pull-ups (many modules have them). Common GND required. Scan address first (0x27/0x3C/0x68/0x76 common).
sensors.analog: ESP32 ADC is nonlinear near rails; average 16-64 samples. Keep sensor GND star-connected.

motors.name: Motors + drivers
rules: NEVER from Arduino 5V pin or breadboard rails — separate supply with common GND
Small DC: L298N (lossy) or TB6612 (better). Servo: separate 5V 2A+, signal pin only from MCU
Back-EMF: driver boards include diodes; bare transistors need flyback diode
Stalled motor browns out MCU — symptom: resets when motor starts

pwm.name: PWM
pwm.esp32: ledcAttach(pin, freq, resolution). LED dim ~5kHz, motor ~20kHz (above audible), servo = 50Hz pulses not duty%.
gotchas: Dim LED flicker on camera = normal aliasing

mqtt.name: MQTT (ESP32 IoT)
checklist: Same WiFi subnet + reachable broker IP (ping it)
Topic spelling/case must match exactly; check leading slash
QoS0 + retained LWT for beginners; add reconnect backoff
gotchas: University/cafe AP isolation blocks LAN MQTT

code.name: Beginner firmware issues (C/C++ Arduino + MicroPython)
arduino: delay() blocking MQTT/WiFi — use millis() state machine
String concatenation fragments RAM → resets; prefer char buffers
Float in ISR / Serial.print in ISR crashes
micropython: Blocking connect loop with no timeout bricks headless boards
Pin numbering: machine.Pin(2) is GPIO2, not D2 label
